title: IPTV
description: The live TV channels, films and series of your own Xtream Codes IPTV account on the centre screen, in the style of UHF: favourites with what is on now, the TV guide, every category, search, and a full-screen player with the guide and the channel list over the picture. Sign in once from your phone (QR code): the login stays on this car's head unit, never in the app. The picture shows while parked (a setting lets a passenger watch while driving); the sound plays on the car's speakers; the steering wheel's skip changes the channel. Needs the IPTV service and a GPU renderer from the Store.
